% Pages of a PDF included with pdfpages and the class option dvips, which
% loads pdfpages' driver ppdvips.def. The run space includes spaced.pdf, a
% PDF of 2 pages found through \graphicspath in a folder whose name has a
% space, with no lastpage hint: extractbb reads no number of pages, so the
% page shows page 1 alone, with ppdvips.def's warning in the TeX log. The
% run dash includes every page of four.pdf after it, and shows all 4.
% ppdvips.def finds a PDF only by its name with .pdf. Each run starts with
% a paragraph "Run name."
\documentclass[dvips]{article}
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\graphicspath{{test-pdfpages/my dir/}}
\begin{document}
Run space.
\includepdf[pages=-]{spaced.pdf}

Run dash.
\includepdf[pages=-]{test-pdfpages/four.pdf}

Run end.
\end{document}
